name: quenching
description: Marketplace hosting quenching-hud, the band above the prompt that shows the worktree's active quenching spec. The quenching surface itself is not a plugin: it is installed into each target repository with `cq deploy`.

plugins.name: quenching-hud
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: the worktree's active quenching spec, its stage and task progress, read through cq specs status --no-fetch. Runs only git branch --show-current and cq specs status; writes no spec or branch and never fetches: it reads the local refs/remotes/origin/quenching, so the band can lag the remote.
